title: A Autopsy for the Parish
author: Mirabel Nakamura
blurb: Ulyana Galloway, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
